## Spec

IdentityProviderSpec is one OpenID Provider (§8.2-8.4); the object name is the provider id used in URLs.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `spec.allowedDomains` | `[]string` | AllowedDomains, when set, restricts logins to verified emails in these domains (reserved).<br>Items: at most 64 |
| `spec.audiences` | `[]string` | Audiences are extra aud values accepted for bearer ID tokens.<br>Items: at most 64 |
| `spec.claimMappings` | `object` | ClaimMappings turns claims into a username and groups (§8.4). |
| `spec.claimMappings.displayName` | `object` | ClaimRef maps a claim or string expression; empty selects the default claim.<br>Validation: claim and expression are mutually exclusive (`!(has(self.claim) && has(self.expression))`) |
| `spec.claimMappings.displayName.claim` | `string` | Length: 1 to 256 |
| `spec.claimMappings.displayName.expression` | `string` | Length: 1 to 4096 |
| `spec.claimMappings.email` | `object` | ClaimRef maps a claim or string expression; empty selects the default claim.<br>Validation: claim and expression are mutually exclusive (`!(has(self.claim) && has(self.expression))`) |
| `spec.claimMappings.email.claim` | `string` | Length: 1 to 256 |
| `spec.claimMappings.email.expression` | `string` | Length: 1 to 4096 |
| `spec.claimMappings.groups` | `object` | PrefixedClaim maps a claim or expression and prepends a prefix. An empty mapping selects the provider's default claim behavior.<br>Validation: claim and expression are mutually exclusive (`!(has(self.claim) && has(self.expression))`) |
| `spec.claimMappings.groups.claim` | `string` | Length: 1 to 256 |
| `spec.claimMappings.groups.expression` | `string` | Length: 1 to 4096 |
| `spec.claimMappings.groups.prefix` | `string` | Length: at most 256 |
| `spec.claimMappings.username` | `object` | PrefixedClaim maps a claim or expression and prepends a prefix. An empty mapping selects the provider's default claim behavior.<br>Validation: claim and expression are mutually exclusive (`!(has(self.claim) && has(self.expression))`) |
| `spec.claimMappings.username.claim` | `string` | Length: 1 to 256 |
| `spec.claimMappings.username.expression` | `string` | Length: 1 to 4096 |
| `spec.claimMappings.username.prefix` | `string` | Length: at most 256 |
| `spec.claimValidationRules` | `[]object` | Items: at most 64 |
| `spec.claimValidationRules[].claim` | `string` | Length: 1 to 256 |
| `spec.claimValidationRules[].expression` | `string` | Expression evaluates signed claims and must produce a boolean.<br>Length: 1 to 4096 |
| `spec.claimValidationRules[].requiredValue` | `string` | RequiredValue defaults to the empty string for scalar equality.<br>Length: at most 2048 |
| `spec.cliClientID` | `string` | CLIClientID is the public client of `kudurru login` (v0.2); bearer ID tokens may carry it as their audience.<br>Length: at most 256 |
| `spec.clientID` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: 1 to 256 |
| `spec.clientSecretRef` | `object` | **Required.** ClientSecretRef selects an operator-granted credential capability.<br>Validation: exactly one credential reference is required (`[has(self.secretRef), has(self.file), has(self.env)].filter(x, x).size() == 1`) |
| `spec.clientSecretRef.env` | `string` | Pattern: `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`<br>Length: at most 128 |
| `spec.clientSecretRef.file` | `string` | Length: 1 to 4096 |
| `spec.clientSecretRef.secretRef` | `object` | CredentialSecretRef names a key in the operator's credential namespace. Namespace selection belongs to host configuration, never to this reference. |
| `spec.clientSecretRef.secretRef.key` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: 1 to 253 |
| `spec.clientSecretRef.secretRef.name` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: 1 to 253 |
| `spec.displayName` | `string` | Length: at most 256 |
| `spec.issuer` | `string` | **Required.**<br>Length: 1 to 2048 |
| `spec.provisioning` | `object` | Provisioning is the first-login policy (§8.4). |
| `spec.provisioning.autoProvision` | `string` | AutoProvision is mapped-only (default), always or never.<br>One of: `mapped-only`, `always`, `never` |
| `spec.provisioning.defaultRole` | `string` | Length: at most 63 |
| `spec.provisioning.syncGroups` | `boolean` |  |
| `spec.redirectURL` | `string` | RedirectURL is the absolute callback URL registered at the IdP.<br>Length: at most 2048 |
| `spec.scopes` | `[]string` | Items: at most 64 |

IdentityProviderStatus reports discovery.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `status.conditions` | `[]Condition` | Items: at most 16<br>List type: `map`, keyed by `type` |

## Example

`config/samples/kudurru.io_v1alpha1_identityprovider.yaml`:

```yaml
apiVersion: kudurru.io/v1alpha1
kind: IdentityProvider
metadata:
  name: corp
spec:
  issuer: https://sso.example.com/realms/home
  clientID: kudurru
  clientSecretRef:
    secretRef:
      name: oidc-client
      key: secret
  redirectURL: https://dns.example.com/api/v1/auth/oidc/corp/callback
```
